F. Israel consumes tons of chicken per person but little pork.

Confidence level: High

Source: A 2019 study by the National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) of the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) found that, among OECD countries, Israel had the highest per capita chicken consumption, with an average of 54 pounds (24.5 kg) per person per year, while pork consumption was relatively low.

ANSWER: F

B. The United States consumes tons of chicken but little pork.

According to the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), in 2018, the United States ranked first among the top 10 countries in per capita consumption of chicken, with an estimated 43.4 kg consumed per person annually. In contrast, the United States ranked 66th in per capita pork consumption, with an estimated 16.4 kg consumed per person annually.

ANSWER: B

C. The United States consumes tons of chicken but little pork. 

**Confidence:** High.  This is based on well-established dietary trends and data from the USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service. (https://www.ams.usda.gov/quickstats)

ANSWER: C
